skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Polar Catcher
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Polar Catcher. The nations of Terra collectively sent a dozen or so survey groups to scale Sami's perilous peaks. Only Team Aurora funded by Karlan Trade Co. ultimately scaled the summits without hassle, planting their flags and beacons at the peaks.
skins.usage: One of Aurora's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Hi, are you there? Can you hear me, Maggy? This is Aurora! I made it to the summit!'
